purpose: Backend variant of the registered protocol physical-p2-barrier-stage1-dense for the Cells backend gpu (L4): same case, observables, phases, mapping and tolerance derivation, plus measured backend terms (tolerance_derivation.backend_terms). The registered purpose follows. Rung 2 (P2, ECM barriers), stage (i): judge Cells' own physics (resolved_pump_tissue@2) on the rung-1 mammal default world with BETSE's tight-junction (0.05; Cl x0.5, Ca x0.25) and adherens (0.5) ECM diffusivity maps against the BETSE-order emulator with Cells' face rule: compact faces with the harmonic coefficient 2 D_a D_b / (D_a + D_b), at BETSE's dt / 100, BETSE's constants, SIM from its own INIT end (reference below). Same discretisation as Cells, so the tolerances exclude the stencil term and this stage discriminates the barrier. Stage (ii) (emulator-p2-barrier-stage2-dense) ties this reference to plain BETSE.

tolerance_derivation.method: 3 x (sum of measured difference terms), rounded up to one significant figure; per ion for concentrations (a zero sum gets the floor 1e-12)

backend_terms.rule: new sum = registered sums_before_margin + these terms; new tolerance = max(registered tolerance, 3 x new sum rounded up to one significant figure, floor 1e-12)

cells_cpu_vs_l4_backend.role: judged CPU run vs blind L4 run A

cells_l4_run_to_run.role: blind L4 run A vs blind L4 run B

observable_mapping: BETSE vm in this world is cell charge / (cm * sum mem_sa), uniform within a cell (Phi_b = 0; v_env not subtracted; sim.py:2029). Cells vm_ave = Q_cell / sum C_patch with C_patch = cm * mem_sa, broadcast to membranes for vm. Patch voltages and exterior potentials are diag_* arrays, reported only. Boundary-ring ECM sites are excluded: BETSE resets them each step, the resolved model holds them as reservoirs.
notes: Reported only: venv_time (BETSE's screened, smoothed estimate has no Cells counterpart) and Cells diag_* arrays.
Gate open fraction is not in the comparison layout and is not judged.

Judged with cells_betse_compare.py compare --betse CASE --cells LAYOUT: the protocol's reference block makes the comparator judge the Cells layout against the reference layout's arrays (pinned by manifest_sha256), with the BETSE case's geometry, ion order, axes and units.
venv_time stays reported only (the reference carries BETSE's screened estimate, Cells none).

The emulator terms are measured with harmonic faces on, at dt/10 (and the gate term also at dt/100, within 3 % of dt/10); the reference's own step error is |x(dt/10) - x(dt/100)| / 9, first order confirmed by h-dt10/30/100/300 (emulator-01/reference_order_check.json; recipe checks).

L4 variant (parity-l4-20261111-01): backend terms from the judged CPU run of physical_p2_barrier_stage1_dense.json (/mnt/workspaces/Cells/parity-rung2-4-20261109-03/stage1/run/layout) and two blind L4 runs (/mnt/workspaces/Cells/parity-l4-20261111-01/blind-A/p2-barrier/run, /mnt/workspaces/Cells/parity-l4-20261111-01/blind-B/p2-barrier/run) from snapshot c819a4e41e5f61829ee604cfc3081f75408c0da2; the backend term also contains any engine difference between the two snapshots (the engine commits in between are recorded as leaving default trajectories unchanged).
L4 runs are not bitwise reproducible run to run; cells_l4_run_to_run measures that.

cells_run.note: as rung 1 (D) with the barrier as input data only; field solver @3 because @2 refuses this world at its rounding floor (1, 0.5 and 2 ms; parity-rung2-4-20261109-01 blind-01, blind-03). Judged runs on CPU; the Cells-only terms were measured on the L4 (blind-01), which differs from CPU only at rounding level
cells_run.mapping: default_world_adapter.resolved_definition: D_env (init_final.npz) per square; face diffusivity 2 D_a D_b / (D_a + D_b); field_solver declared @3 (opt-in; bitwise @2 wherever @2 converges)

reference.run: validation/betse/default_world_adapter.py run --constants betse --dt-factor 100 --sim-start chained --model-difference compact_ecm_faces_harmonic (emulator; no Cells engine model)

discrimination_ratio.definition: the option's own effect (max over samples and phase end, interior ECM) divided by this protocol's tolerance, per phase and quantity (ion); ions at the 1e-12 floor (immobile P) are left out

non_discriminating_causes.init/voltage: the barrier moves Vm by about 9 uV; the tolerance is set by X_ext (Cells' within-cell patch-voltage spread, 2.1 uV) and the constants term
non_discriminating_causes.sim/voltage: the barrier moves Vm by about 9 uV; the tolerance is set by X_ext (Cells' within-cell patch-voltage spread, 2.1 uV) and the constants term
non_discriminating_causes.init/cell_concentration/Ca: phase max set by the reference's early Ca transient, peak at t = 0.06 s

non_discriminating_rule: Quantities listed here (ratio <= 1) are still judged, but the option's effect does not exceed their tolerance, so no claim about the option may rest on them.
status: REGISTERED L4 variant (lead, main, 11 November 2026, before any judged L4 run): numbers from the registered protocol's derivation plus measured Cells-vs-Cells backend terms; no L4 Cells-vs-BETSE difference has been computed. To be committed by the lead before any judged L4 run.
